title: Dropout voltage at 50mA load (Vin sweep toward Vout, DR-003/gf180 convention)
claim: Substantiates spec/target-spec.md's DRAFT "Dropout @ 50 mA" row (< 300mV, DRAFT stretch < 200mV) against the LDO core-regulation-loop schematic landed by #14 (design/ldo_3v3in_1v8out.sch), using the DRAFT row's own cited method ("gf180's ss/125C/Vin~=Vout+dropout convention"): fix I_LOAD at 50mA (the row's own test point) and sweep Vin down toward Vout to find the Vin-Vout margin at which regulation is lost, rather than sweeping load current at a single ample Vin (that measures load regulation, a different DRAFT row). That row is DRAFT (issue #1 not yet ratified) -- the bound below cites it directly, not an invented final limit, and needs re-verification once #1 rules. dropout_v reports the Vin-Vout margin at the sweep's lowest Vin point (worst-case headroom); vout_at_max_vin_v is a light-headroom regulation sanity check at the sweep's top end.
statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix check, not a distribution claim)

measurements.name: dropout_v
measurements.note: Vin - Vout at the sweep's lowest Vin point (1.9V, just above the 1.8V DRAFT output target) with I_LOAD fixed at 50mA -- the worst-case headroom this sweep exercises. DRAFT bound: spec/target-spec.md "Dropout @ 50 mA" row, < 300mV (DRAFT stretch < 200mV, not applied here).

measurements.name: vout_at_max_vin_v
measurements.note: Vout at the sweep's highest Vin point (3.63V, ample headroom -- index 34 of the 35-point 1.9V..3.63V/0.05V sweep). A wide sanity-range check (not a tight spec bound) that regulation is at least in a sane operating range at the sweep's easiest point.
